title: Increasing the Inference and Learning Speed of Tsetlin Machines with Clause Indexing
new_feature: Clause indexing: a look-up table indexing clauses by the literals that falsify them (inclusion lists + position matrix with constant-time updates), so clause evaluation iterates only over falsifying literals instead of all clauses, during both inference and learning.

datasets.booleanization: 1 to 4 threshold-based grey levels per pixel (M1..M4)
binary presence features; selection method not stated
1 to 4 bits per pixel by thresholding

extraction_notes: Paper reports only speedup ratios (no accuracy). All entries of Tables 1-3 included (5 clause counts x 4 feature sizes x train/test). Headline: up to ~15x inference speedup on IMDb (15.87 max), ~3x training speedup on MNIST; indexing slows IMDb training ~10%. Absolute times only in log-scale figures (not extracted). Hardware not stated.
